title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 599 East Genesse Street in Fayetteville, New York, as the George H. Bacel Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 599 East Genesse [sic] Street in Fayetteville, New York, as the "George H. Bacel Post Office Building."

summary.headline: A law that names a post office building in Fayetteville, New York, after George H. Bacel.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 599 East Genesee Street in Fayetteville, New York, as the George H. Bacel Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or how the building operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021, and the renaming took effect on that date.
